subject: [PATCH v5 11/12] mm/mempolicy: read the zoneref slot once in mempolicy_slab_node()

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the mempolicy_slab_node() function by reading the zoneref slot only once, instead of twice. This prevents a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug that occurs when a movable block in the zonelist goes offline while a task's slab_strict_numa allocation is held between two reads. The fix involves storing the zone reference in a variable and reusing it to look up the node's index.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Applied the Reviewed-by tag without providing any additional feedback or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Sat Oct 31, 2026 at 10:13 PM EDT, Gregory Price (Meta) wrote:
> For a bind or preferred-many policy, mempolicy_slab_node() tests the
> first matching slot's zone for NULL, then reads the slot again to look
> up the zone's node. Offlining a zone's last block rebuilds the
> zonelists in place, so the second read can return the terminator:
>
>   CPU 0                             CPU 1
>   mempolicy_slab_node()
>     zonelist_zone(slot 4)
>       = node 2 NORMAL
>                                     offline_pages()
>                                       build_all_zonelists()
>                                         slot 4 = NULL
>     zonelist_node_idx(slot 4)
>       zone_to_nid(NULL)
>
> Current GCC merges the two reads, but nothing requires it. With
> mm/mempolicy.o built with -fno-inline -fno-ipa-sra, holding a bound
> task's slab_strict_numa allocation between the reads while a movable
> block earlier in the zonelist goes offline oopses every time:
>
>   BUG: kernel NULL pointer dereference, address: 0000000000000060
>   RIP: 0010:zone_to_nid+0x0/0x10
>   Call Trace:
>    kmem_cache_alloc_noprof+0x294/0x610
>    do_getname+0x34/0x230
>
> mempolicy_slab_node() and zonelist_node_idx() are tail calls here, so
> neither appears in the trace.
>
> Read the slot once and use that zone.
>
> Fixes: 11cd8638c37f ("mm, page_alloc: remove stop_machine from build_all_zonelists")
> Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
> Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
> Reviewed-by: Vlastimil Babka (SUSE) <vbabka@kernel.org>
> ---
>  mm/mempolicy.c | 4 +++-
>  1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)
>

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-11-02.patch_summary: This patch addresses a double-put bug in the mm/mempolicy code by reading the zoneref slot only once in mempolicy_slab_node(). The fix involves removing the redundant read and using the previously obtained zone reference to avoid a null pointer dereference.
